mapper.sql: SELECT lv.id AS layout_version_id, l.id AS layout_id, l.created_by, l.title, lv.version AS layout_version_number, lv.status AS layout_version_status, fp.width, fp.height FROM layout_versions lv JOIN layouts l ON l.id = lv.layout_id JOIN floor_plans fp ON fp.id = l.floor_plan_id WHERE lv.id = #{layoutVersionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, layout_version_id, parent_simulation_id, created_by, status, created_at, requested_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_message FROM simulations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_version_id, parent_simulation_id, created_by, status, created_at, requested_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_message FROM simulations WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, simulation_id, random_seed, model_profile, routing_profile, total_people, walking_speed, reaction_time FROM simulation_options WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT id, simulation_id, center_x, center_y, radius FROM hazard_zones WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT layout_exit_id FROM simulation_exits WHERE simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY layout_exit_id ASC

SELECT sr.id, sr.simulation_id, sr.engine_version, sr.termination_reason, sr.frame_interval_seconds, sr.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timelines t WHERE t.simulation_result_id = sr.id) AS timeline_chunk_count FROM simulation_results sr WHERE sr.simulation_id = #{simulationId}
SELECT id, simulation_result_id, unit, metric_type, metric_value FROM simulation_metrics WHERE simulation_result_id = #{simulationResultId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulations (layout_version_id, parent_simulation_id, created_by, status) VALUES (#{layoutVersionId}, #{parentSimulationId}, #{createdBy}, #{status})

INSERT INTO simulation_options (simulation_id, random_seed, model_profile, routing_profile, total_people, walking_speed, reaction_time) VALUES (#{simulationId}, #{randomSeed}, #{modelProfile}, #{routingProfile}, #{totalPeople}, #{walkingSpeed}, #{reactionTime})
INSERT INTO simulation_initial_states (simulation_id, agent_positions) VALUES (#{simulationId}, CAST(#{agentPositions} AS JSON))

INSERT INTO hazard_zones (simulation_id, center_x, center_y, radius) VALUES
(#{hazard.simulationId}, #{hazard.centerX}, #{hazard.centerY}, #{hazard.radius})

INSERT INTO simulation_exits (simulation_id, layout_exit_id, layout_version_id) VALUES
(#{simulationId}, #{layoutExitId}, #{layoutVersionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_versions SET status = '잠금' WHERE id = #{layoutVersionId} AND status = '초안'

UPDATE simulations SET status = 'REQUESTED', requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'FAILED')
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{simulationId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE simulations SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_message = #{message} WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulation_results (simulation_id, engine_version, termination_reason, frame_interval_seconds) VALUES (#{simulationId}, #{engineVersion}, #{terminationReason}, #{frameIntervalSeconds})

INSERT INTO simulation_metrics (simulation_result_id, unit, metric_type, metric_value) VALUES
(#{metric.simulationResultId}, #{metric.unit}, #{metric.metricType}, #{metric.metricValue})
INSERT INTO timelines (simulation_result_id, chunk_sequence, frame_data) VALUES (#{simulationResultId}, #{chunkSequence}, CAST(#{frameData} AS JSON))
